sloka: भरतेनापि सन्दिष्टा सम्मर्दो न भवेदिऺति।समन्तात्तस्य शैलस्य सेना वासमकल्पयत् ॥ २.९७.२९॥
transliteration: bharatenāpi sandiṣṭā sammardo na bhavediऺti।samantāttasya śailasya senā vāsamakalpayat ॥ 2.97.29॥

translations.english: Let not the hermitage be crowded commanded Bharata, and the army encamped around the mountain.
